title: Anchor with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Shank -->
  <rect x='46' y='20' width='8' height='48' rx='4' fill='#C0C0C0'/>
  <!-- Highlight on shank -->
  <rect x='48' y='22' width='3' height='44' rx='1.5' fill='#E8E8E8'/>
  <!-- Ring at top -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='16' r='7' fill='none' stroke='#C0C0C0' stroke-width='4'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='16' r='7' fill='none' stroke='#E8E8E8' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-dasharray='3 5'/>
  <!-- Crossbar (stock) -->
  <rect x='28' y='32' width='44' height='7' rx='3.5' fill='#A0A0A0'/>
  <rect x='30' y='33.5' width='40' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#D0D0D0'/>
  <!-- Left arm -->
  <path d='M22 66 Q18 82 38 86' fill='none' stroke='#A0A0A0' stroke-width='8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M22 66 Q18 82 38 86' fill='none' stroke='#D0D0D0' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Right arm -->
  <path d='M78 66 Q82 82 62 86' fill='none' stroke='#A0A0A0' stroke-width='8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M78 66 Q82 82 62 86' fill='none' stroke='#D0D0D0' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Left fluke -->
  <path d='M34 84 L26 92 L32 82 Z' fill='#909090'/>
  <path d='M34 84 L26 92 L32 82 Z' fill='none' stroke='#D0D0D0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- Right fluke -->
  <path d='M66 84 L74 92 L68 82 Z' fill='#909090'/>
  <path d='M66 84 L74 92 L68 82 Z' fill='none' stroke='#D0D0D0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- Face plate -->
  <rect x='38' y='45' width='24' height='16' rx='6' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='52' r='2.5' fill='#333333'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='52' r='2.5' fill='#333333'/>
  <!-- Eye shine -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='51' r='1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='51' r='1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M44 57 Q50 62 56 57' fill='none' stroke='#333333' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Blush -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='56' r='2.5' fill='#FF9999' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='56' r='2.5' fill='#FF9999' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
